title: Quick Malty Ukrainian Couscous Grill
description: A paleo-friendly Ukrainian dish featuring malty couscous and ferment-kimchi, cooked to perfection on a raclette-grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to medium-high heat.
In a medium bowl, cook the couscous according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onion to the raclette-grill and cook for 3 minutes per side.
Add the marinated chicken breast to the raclette-grill and cook for 5 minutes per side.
Add the minced garlic to the raclette-grill and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ferment-kimchi and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork and stir in the malty flavor.
Serve the chicken and onion mixture over the couscous.
